Song Ah has to look for a new accompanist when her last one quits. She asks her acquaintances for help, but she has no luck. Just then, Joon Young offers to play for her. People find out that Song Ah and Joon Young are dating and that Joon Young is playing for Song Ah's grad school exam. Rumors about them spread like wildfire, which makes Song Ah doubt if she made the right decision. Meanwhile, Joon Young looks for paid work performing at a concert.

With Jung Kyung constantly asking Joon Young whether he still has feelings for her, Joon Young once again tells her how he feels. Later, Song Ah questions Joon Young about his whereabouts last night after seeing him and Jung Kyung ride off in a taxi. When Director Nah asks Joon Young a favor regarding Jung Kyung, he turns down her request. Meanwhile, Song Ah is going through a hard time herself and makes a decision that should've been made a long time ago.

The recording of Yoo Tae Jin playing "Traumerei" goes viral. However, it turns out that Joon Young performed the music, not Tae Jin. He demands Tae Jin take the recording down, but he refuses. Jung Kyung helps Joon Young by successfully convincing Tae Jin to take the recording down. Song Ah runs into Jung Kyung and hears about the recording and how much it means to Joon Young. In the end, she decides to break up with Joon Young.

After breaking up with Joon Young, Song Ah continues with her entrance exam as if nothing happened. On the other hand, Joon Young feels very bad that he hurt Song Ah. In spite of the dissuasion, Joon Young decides to quit playing the piano. Meanwhile, Director Nah passes away. At the funeral, when Song Ah tells Joon Young about her recital and her plans as a violinist, Joon Young asks her if he can be her accompanist.

While Joon Young continues to wait for Song Ah's answer, Joon Young, Jung Kyung, and Hyeon Ho perform together at Director Nah's commemoration concert. Later, Song Ah shares the news regarding her admission offer from the graduate school with Joon Young. As Song Ah listens attentively to Joon Young's piano performance at his recital, she realizes that her feelings toward Joon Young are solid and carefully opens up to him once again.

Lee Soon finds out Ok Jung intends to make armor and lets her watch the military training. Meanwhile, Ok Jung encounters bandits, who see Ok Jung leveling her sword and shoot an arrow toward Lee Soon. But Ok Jung complains to Lee Soon all the more.

Lee Soon, preparing to spend the night with Inkyeong, hears Hyeonjong is in critical condition and runs to his side. Meanwhile, Ok Jung is advised by Jo Sa Seok, who has come to Buyongjeong, to try and become a court lady.

Ok Jung seeks out Jo Sa Seok, saying she will enter the palace. She asks him to free her mother and send her to the seamstress's chamber where she can make clothes. Meanwhile, Chi Soo, hearing Ok Jung wishes to enter the palace, says they should leave for China together.

Lee Soon carries out Prince Boksun's execution for attempting treason. Meanwhile, Jang Hyeon seeks out Jo Sa Seok, saying there seems to be a romantic attachment between Ok Jung and Lee Soon. He asks for a straw mat to be laid down through the Grand Queen Dowager's palace.

Lee Soon goes to the seamstress's chamber seeking Ok Jung, saying he has come to have his measurements taken. But not seeing Ok Jung, he is disappointed. Meanwhile, Ok Jung, while struggling with rain-soaked laundry, happens to meet Lee Soon.

Prince Dongpyeong, asking Lee Soon whether he has a woman he loves, says they should share a pleasant chat over a cup of wine. Meanwhile, at Yang Goon's order to bring a blanket, Ok Jung heads toward the office where Lee Soon has fallen asleep.

Though she's been groomed for stardom all her life by an overbearing mother (Minnie Driver), singer Noni (Gugu Mbatha-Raw) is having trouble dealing with her success. Feeling unable to cope any longer, Noni tries to kill herself, but luckily Kaz (Nate Parker), the police officer assigned to be her bodyguard, thwarts her suicide attempt. Noni and Kaz feel an instant attraction, but those in their orbit oppose the romance for fear the pair will stray from the course planned out for both of them.

A writer (Erica Tazel) who has sworn off trying to find love is unexpectedly swept off her feet by a seemingly perfect man (Columbus Short). Things get complicated when she learns he works for a dating service.

Young couple Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) and Kisha (Essence Atkins) have just moved into their dream home. As they settle in, they learn that they're not alone -- not because the house is haunted, but because Kisha is possessed by a demon. Desperate to salvage his relationship -- and more importantly -- his sex life -- Malcolm hires a coterie of paranormal specialists, which includes a priest and ghostbusters, to banish the unwelcome intruder from Kisha's body.

After the ordeal he suffered with his now former girlfriend's (Essence Atkins) demonic possession, Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) has decided to start fresh. He has a new girlfriend named Megan (Jaime Pressly), and they and Megan's children are moving into their dream home. Soon afterward, Malcolm is once again plagued by supernatural shenanigans -- only this time, it's not just the house that's haunted. A demon has attached itself to Malcolm, and shows no signs of letting go.

Sleet and Dingo plan to collect the taxes owed to Robotnik from the Duke of Velcronia but keep it for themselves.
The sinister Robotnik blackmails Cyrus, an old friend of Sonic's, by holding his father hostage.
When Hacker, an adolescent mole computer whiz steals a super-intelligence program from Robotnik's computer, Sonic has to protect him, smashing Grounder to pieces.
Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails.

Robotnik installs a new "obedience microchip" in Scratch and Grounder and orders them to drill for a rare mineral in a tropical mountain. With his Freezomatic machine, Robotnik covers the mountain in ice and runs a Hermit out of his home.

When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff "unworthy".

Professor Von Schlemmer (from Too Tall Tails) has created a machine which brings dreams to life. When Robotnik hears about it, he forces the Professor to alter the machine so that nightmares come to life.

Robotnik invents a Brain Evolution Achievement Negatizer, or B.E.A.N., in order to make all of Mobius stupid. But instead of turning Sonic and Tails into dummies, the BEAN device turns them into three year old babies!
Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness.

Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake.
Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his "brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer" to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver).

When Sally uncovers Robotnik's plan to seed the cloud with toxic rain, they attempt a daring mission to sabotage the dirigible-like craft being transported by land vehicles. Mission fails when Sally, Bunnie and Antoine are captured.

When Sonic and The Freedom Fighters take out Robotnik's main computer, they're trapped by Swat-Bots in an underground tunnel, only to be rescued by a handsome teenager named Griff. Griff takes them deep beneath the Big City.
Robotnik severely upsets the ecosystem above and below the surface, when he sends explosive, Robotnik snake probes drilling deep under ground in search of oil lakes.

programmes.d: Mahler's Symphony No. 9, a profoundly emotional and technically complex work from 1909-1910, is characterized by its sprawling, late-Romantic style, exploring themes of human experience, love, and existential questions against the backdrop of Mahler's own impending death. Audiences are drawn to the symphony's deeply personal expression of vulnerability and its transcendent final movement, which serves as a poignant farewell and a profound exploration of the human condition.

Raspberry is distraught when she suspects her friends have copied her design on her lantern for the "Glimmerberry Gathering".

While sipping cider in Strawberry's café, the girls muse about how they cannot wait for winter to arrive. They list the various traditions they love about the season but the one they all agree on is the Glimmerberry Ball. Strawberry mentions that she doesn't think the café can hold the party this year because of how the town has grown. The girls decide to split up and search for a new location.

Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

With all the Baby Berrykins running around Berry Bitty City, Princess Berrykin decides to build a Day Care Center and playground. But she's worried because it's dull-looking - all grey metal and brown wood. She asks Strawberry whom might be good to help her out. And two names immediately come to her mind - Lemon and Raspberry! The Princess confesses she's always admired their sense of design and style.

After returning to the café after a walk with her pets, Strawberry is met by Mr. Longface. He's been waiting for her so that they can get started making treats and decorating for Sadiebug's and Kadiebug's party that afternoon. But Custard and Pupcake have enjoyed their time outside so much that they want to continue playing.

Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. While construction is going on, the girls each show Strawberry their individual ideas for the bedroom.

With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. The girls are blown away when their berryjuice cell phone gets a text message that Cherry accepts their invitation! Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! Strawberry and the girls are thrilled that she will be with them for a little longer, and they do all they can to make their guest comfortable. But Cherry doesn't want to be treated like a guest  she wants to fit in and contribute to the community.

Berry Bitty City is holding its first city-wide talent show! Hearing that it's the music students of superstar Cherry Jam, a talent scout from Big Bitty City plans to show up. Strawberry and her friends excitedly anticipate her arrival.

Raspberry is discovered by a talent scout who wants her to move to Berry Big City and design a new line of Glitter fashions! She will be provided with her own studio, staff, publicity, commitments from big department stores-everything she needs to be a big fashion designing star! All her friends are thrilled for her. Only Cherry is a bit less enthusiastic about Raspberry's stardom, which Raspberry mistakenly interprets as jealousy.

It's the last week of summer and Berry Bitty City is hopping with activity as the girls prepare for their tropical island vacation at Berry Breezy Bay Resort. But just as they're about to leave, bad news: the resort is closed for the season due to berry breezy weather. The girls are disappointed, but Orange isn't giving up. She says if they can't go to the tropical island, maybe they can bring the tropical island here!

With only a few days of summer left, the girls are about to enjoy their first vacation in their newly-created, tropical beach resort at Berry Bitty Lake, when who should descend upon them but Mavis Maraschino, the comically over-the-top "Entertainment Tonight"-style show host. Mavis has dumped her focus on fashions in favor of an even glitzier show called Lifestyles of the Berry Big Bitty Stars, and she wants her first segment to be about how pop superstar Cherry Jam spends her vacation.

On a beautiful winter's night, Blueberry reads the Baby Berrykins a story of what happened one winter in Berry Bitty City-a winter that almost wasn't. Just as everyone is ready for winter fun and fashions, a sudden warming melts the snow and ruins their plans. Improvising with snowmen made of shaved ice and cotton puffs, Strawberry and her friends play "Capture the Snowman's Carrot Nose." The Berrykins want to join in the fun, so the girls play against them, with Strawberry refereeing.

Pati explores some unique spots in Guadalajara where food and art truly connect. In her kitchen, she makes pollo a la valentina, rice with poblanos and corn, and an almond tres leches cake.

No trip to Yucatán is complete without seeing a beautiful cenote, natural freshwater pools in caves. To learn more about Mayan communities, Pati visits Cenote Xocempich with lawyer Zoila Cen, who has dedicated her career to helping Mayan people.

Pati arrives in Motul, a town in the history books for Yucatán's once thriving henequén industry and for the egg dish Huevos Motuleños. Pati meets Doña Evelia, who put Motul back on the map with her world-famous recipe.

programmes.st: An Underground Pit of Cochinita Pibil
programmes.d: Pati visits Chef Wilson Alonzo in his hometown of Halachó to prepare a traditional Cochinita Pibil in an underground pit. Pati helps Wilson prepare the achiote marinade, along with his grandmother who taught him traditional cooking.

Pati returns to Mérida to meet sisters, Delia and Maria Elide, who love to cook and laugh and are famous for recados - pastes of spices and aromatic herbs that season Yucatecan foods. In Uxmal, she learns about ingredients that make recados unique.

Pati explores the streets of Yucatán's capital, Mérida. She tries the best tacos in Mérida at Wayan'e. The aroma of freshly made cookies lures her to Dondé Fabric, where their globitos and bizcochitos are an important part of Mérida's mornings.

Pati meets the young chefs behind one of Guadalajara's most exciting restaurants, Xokol. Back home, Pati invites her friend Francisco Migoya over to make conchas to go with pellizcadas with chicharrón in salsa verde.

DNA Analysis: With the advent of DNA analysis, just a few microscopic cells found at a crime scene can be used to put a murder behind bars.

Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.
The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Some are runaways who find their way home, but others simply disappear. When foul play is suspected, investigators turn to forensics to find the missing.

programmes.d: Doug To the Rescue/Doug's Cool Shoes: When Roger bothers Patti, Doug imagines he's Quailman, a superhero who fights with the powers of a quail. Doug wants to trade in his old sneakers for the new Sky Davis Inflatable Air Jet Shoe.

programmes.st: Doug Gets His Ears Lowered/Doug on the Wild Side
programmes.d: Doug Gets His Ears Lowered/Doug On The Wild Side: Doug narrowly escapes the clutches of crazy hair stylists, including “Fluke,” the most dangerous haircutter in Bluffington. Doug's wild Grandma Opal takes him on an exciting new adventure.

programmes.st: Side by Side / Hooked on Phobics
programmes.d: The Gromble assigns Ickis to be "pair-scare" partners with the dreaded, unpopular Zimbo. Ickis and Zimbo are miserable with the match and instantly start bickering./Ickis discovers as easy way out of getting his homework done.

The Academy instantly shuts down, transforming itself into a camouflaged cave, when a human spy is discovered inside. /The Gromble is in love with the Library Monster, and he's not as strict as he used to be.
Norb instructs Dag in the fine art of cereal box top collecting.  When the cereal company fails to deliver, the boys show up to collect their rightful prize.

programmes.st: Beach Beavers A Go-Go / Deranged Ranger
programmes.d: Dag and Norb resist their natural urge to hibernate and Go-Go South for the winter.  When the Forest Ranger quits, Dag gets himself elected and it's not long before the power goes to his head.

With Nigel and Marianne off exploring bat caves, Eliza and Debbie are left at the eerie residence of Nigel's colleague, Dr. Renfield.  Eliza becomes obsessed with spooking Debbie, when her imagination gets the best of her and the tables are turned.

When Eliza discovers that a local performer claims he can talk to animals she believes she's found a soul mate.  Eliza must enlist the help of some very urban animals to help her sneak into the sideshow and meet The Great Bangaboo.
Eliza convinces a group of Baboon-like apes to stand up against their legendary adversaries- The Others.  Darwin, meanwhile, has met an almost identical group of apes with an identical problem.

Eliza will stop at nothing to get a look at the gigantic, fierce Komodo Dragon that lives on Southeast Asian Islands.  Her plans are halted when the unexpected arrival of her home-schooling teacher forces her to hit the books.

Doug's Big Catch/Doug Needs Money: At the Big Bass-Off fishing contest, Doug teams up with Mr. Dink to catch the fish who stole Dink's wallet 30 years earlier. When Doug and Skeeter accidentally break Mr. Dink's custom grill just before his big barbecue.
The kids and their parents are at Camp Everwood. Chance, a camp counselor, is staging an elaborate musical while Dil is discovering whether or not the camp is haunted.
The kids take an aptitude test to get a clue as to what they want to be when they grow up, but they are not thrilled about the results.
Charlotte lets Angelica redesign her room. The first step: throwing out all the toys. Unfortunately, that also includes Cynthia, Angelica's favorite doll.
An older girl, Francine, picks on Tommy. And Angelica loves every minute of it! Is it possible that Francine likes Tommy, or is she just a pest?
Coming to terms with how their world has changed, the guys decide to take control and with Gustavo plan their first big concert.

The boys return from tour and find Jo flirting with a hot new guy, new kids hanging out at the pool, and loads of schoolwork! With the second leg of their tour starting soon, will life in LA return to the way it was?

The guys are visited by their hometown friend who happens to be an awesome singer, but also the world’s biggest klutz! At the same time, James is visited by a fan whose behavior quickly turns from complimentary to stalker.

James helps Camille run lines for an audition and they end up kissing! Meanwhile, Gustavo tries to set up Carlos with his first girlfriend, and Kendall and Jo try to balance their hectic schedules so they can see each other.
The boys are scheduled to make their first TV appearance, but when it looks like BTR will be bumped from the line-up, they do whatever it takes to make their debut happen.

It’s Halloween in Palm Woodsylvania and the monstrous personas of Big Time Rush come to light. James is a sexy vampire, Logan is a zombie who keeps losing his limbs, Carlos is Franken-Carlos, and Kendall is a werewolf.
Jo’s publicist wants the press to think she’s dating her new co-star, so Kendall and Jo must sneak around and hide their relationship!
After Bellview High nerd, Eric Blonnowitz accidentally punches Drake he finds a newfound world of fame, popularity and girls.
After Drake and Josh accidentally kill Megan's pet hamster, they ready themselves for her revenge that could come anywhere, anytime.

After the boys get in trouble for using Fake ID's Audrey and Walter fear they will fall to a life of crime and sign them up for a "Steered Straight" program, but things start skidding out-of-control when a real criminal befriends them
Megan's been extremely secretive and Drake and Josh investigate to find out what she's up to.
The most popular kid in school is throwing what may be the greatest sixteenth party ever, but Drake and Josh may be having cake for two after they get banned from the party.

After Josh ruins Drake's chances at having a hit song in the Superbowl, the boys must find a way to make things right.   Along for the ride are a crazy houseguest, a  bride, and one really big shrimp.
True and Shelley take on the school's jerk incumbent for class president and VP, but Mikey J. and Lulu join the race against them.
Its Jimmy birthday and True is planning a big surprise party for him, however the day spins out of control when she not only gets assigned a big work project but also has to take her drivers test.
After a newspaper article is written about True, she gets a glimpse of what its feels like to be famous when actor Leon Thomas invites her to an awards show.
Kenan's parents are celebrating their 17th wedding anniversary.  Roger really wants to impress Sheryl, so he visits a friend who owns a jewelry store.
Kel has the worst case of the flu.  Kenan tries to cure him with a homemade remedy consisting of just about everything in the kitchen.
The President of the United States makes a visit to Rigby's during a stop in Chicago.  While walking through the store, he falls prey to a toppling display of orange soda cans the boys have erected.

It's love at first sight when Kenan meets the daughter of his father's boss, Mr. Dawson.  But when the answering machine records more than just him hanging up, Kenan and Kel set out to switch the tape.
Kenan has been saving up all year to buy a Christmas present for himself. To get the last few dollars he needs, he accepts a job as a department store Santa.
The annual Day of Pranks competition at the Palm Woods has arrived and soon a boys vs. girls prank war begins!

Gustavo gets a spiritual guru to help with his anger issues, but when the guru talks Gustavo into letting him run Rocque Records, the boys must do whatever it takes to get back control of Big Time Rush.
The guys are excited to head back to Minnesota for the holidays, but Gustavo’s got them working on a Christmas EP, and won’t let them go home until it’s done.

The guys are excited to head back to Minnesota for the holidays, but Gustavo tells them they have to stay in LA to record a three-song Christmas EP, and it looks like they'll be spending their first Christmas away from home.
Drake wins a free skydive off a helicopter and goes off to do it despite his parents saying no.   Josh, being the good brother he is, tries to stop him, but ends up going along for the ride.
Blessed with his unconventional dance moves, Josh decides to try out for the local dance contest.
Worlds collide when Drake Parker and Josh Nichols, two very different kids attending the same high school, discover that they're about to become stepbrothers.
Drake and Josh get a Dune Buggy that Trevor brought to their house fixed and want to take it out for a spin, but Audrey and Walter think other ways.

The models play a game of flag football with professional football players, during which they pause for photos; the all-stars pose alongside supermodel Coco Rocha.

The models create a signature fragrance and launch the scent at a public event while posing in a bathtub; tension is high during a photo shoot where the women pose as reality stars; guest judge Kathy Griffin.

The Andromeda gets involved in a feud between a Than planet and a Nietzschean colony. Tyr must choose between his clan or his new family aboard the Andromeda.
A slipstream sends the Andromeda back in time to just before the Commonwealth fell. The crew must intervene to preserve history.
Answering a distress call leads the crew to pick up Beka's brother, now a Wayist, and his friend. They are connected to environmentalists trying to prevent space travel.
A black hole allows Dylan to communicate with his former fiancee, 300 years in the past. He can't abandon his mission to reform the Commonwealth, but can he bring her into the future?
Dylan is imprisoned on a prison planet and must stage an escape as his crew tries to stage their own rescue.
Castalians board the Andromeda to finalize the charter for the New Commonwealth. When the leader is discovered dead, Tyr is the main suspect.

programmes.st: The Pearls That Were His Eyes
programmes.d: Beka learns that her father's former business partner deals in a highly addictive drug called Flash. The rest of the crew holds a "garage sale" to earn money for new ship parts.
The Andromeda discovers her "sister ship", the Pax Magellanic.  The crew aboard Pax is 300 years old, but have not aged a day
Tyr crash lands the Eureka Maru on a Nietzschean planet and develops amnesia. He must remember what he is doing before the Nietzscheans discover him and his crate of stolen goods.
Harper receives the "gift" of knowledge from a dying Perseid, only to discover that the Perseid was being hunted by a bounty hunter, who has now turned his attention to Harper.
Dylan is arrested for assassinating a dictator 300 years ago, by the man he helped install in his place. The new dictator ended up being much, much worse.
Andromeda is boarded by a drone from the Consensus of Parts, a mythical mechanical society. While friendly at first, the drone tries to force the ship to join the Consensus.

programmes.st: Fear and Loathing in the Milky Way
programmes.d: Gerentex is back and demands Trance and Harper help him with his new scheme: finding Tarn-Vedra.
Dylan and Rev Bem help a peaceful society stand up to their would-be slavers. They have to be careful because if Dylan teaches them to kill, their kids will be born knowing it.
Dylan attempts to bring peace to two different Nietzschean prides by escorting the princess of one to her arranged marriage to the prince of the other.
Rommie's avatar falls in love with what turns out to be the avatar of a warship named Gabriel. Gabriel attempts to infect Rommie with a virus that broadcasts its plans to the warship.
Beka takes the Andromeda to Tarn-Vedra, but extended time in the slipstream causes side effects. To combat them, Beka starts taking Flash and soon becomes addicted.

One fierce battle ends in Cioccolata’s defeat, but another unfolds after Secco listens to Cioccolata’s revealing final voicemail. Bucciarati sinks into an intense underground struggle to stop Secco from reaching the secret stationed at the Colosseum.

The curtains are down on his skirmish with Secco, but Bucciarati must race against time to reach the Colosseum as he realizes his body is nearing the end of the line. Unfortunately, he’s not the only one who catches on to his deteriorating condition.

Key to defeating the Boss in hand, Polnareff waits for Bucciarati and crew. But the one who appears before him first is none other than the Boss of the Passione himself, Diavolo. The tides may not be the only things shifting in the battle yet to come.

Pierced by the arrow, Silver Chariot transforms into Chariot Requiem, its new power swapping the souls of all living creatures nearby. Realizing the dangers of the arrow in the wrong hands, Giorno and crew scramble to get ahold of it before Diavolo does.

Grotesque disfigurations begin to emerge from the soul-swapped bodies as Chariot Requiem’s frenzy rages on. Bucciarati and crew need to take back the arrow and fast. However, Giorno has a terrifying revelation, stopping everyone in their tracks.

Solving the mystery of Requiem, Diavolo takes control of Trish’s soul and steals the arrow. Attacks do nothing against Emperor Crimson’s time leaps and Eulogy’s predictions. But just as Diavolo is about to pierce his own Stand with the arrow...

Righteous actions born of truth shall never be destroyed. Piercing Golden Wind with the arrow, Giorno draws the final battle against Diavolo to a close. And Diavolo, robbed of the mercy of death, spirals violently into an “end” that never ends.

Months before meeting Giorno, Bucciarati and gang help a local florist chisel out the truth behind his daughter’s apparent suicide. Mista is assigned to track down her lover, whose ties with destiny had unwittingly cast a light upon Bucciarati’s fate.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Dio the Invader

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: A Letter From the Past
programmes.d: Hostility grows between Jonathan and his adopted brother, Dio, as forgotten secrets emerge. Do the sinister slums of London hold the secret to the mask and Jonathan’s suspicions?
Jonathan and his new comrade, Speedwagon, confront Dio but are caught off guard when a savage reversal sends shock waves through the Joestar family.
Fate arranges the meeting of a broken Jonathan and the mysterious Zeppeli, master of Hamon energy. Meanwhile, one particularly savage vampire recruit hopes to slice his way to victory.
Saitama's a guy who’s a hero out of boredom. After saving a child from certain death, he decided to become a hero and trained hard for three years to become 'One Punch Man.'
A monster is moving toward City Z, one created by the mysterious organization known as 'The House of Evolution.'
Saitama and Genos glean information about The House of Evolution and its founder, Dr. Genus.
Battlesuit-clad terrorists called "The Paradisers" appear in City F, led by an enormous man known as Hammerhead.
Maria’s masked servant is none other than Zero’s twin brother, Ichiru, whom Zero has not seen since their separation long ago…
Yuki learns that Maria’s true identity is Shizuka, the pureblood vampire who bit Zero and turned him into a vampire.
After suffering a mortal wound, Shizuka dies in Ichiru’s arms. Meanwhile, Yuki and Zero try to find where Shizuka may have gone, but Zero is constantly thwarted by his Level E seizures…
After Shizuka Hio’s death, peace is restored at the academy. As usual, Yuki is busy with her duties as Guardian when Zero, who has been gone for quite some time, comes back.

Matsuda, the task force member assigned to watch Misa, is eager to distinguish himself.
L's team discovers that the Yotsuba Group meet in secret to discuss the elimination of individuals who are troublesome to their company.
The Yotsuba Group hires Eraldo Coil to uncover L's identity.
Misa succeeds in narrowing down the Kira suspects in the Yotsuba Group to one: Higuchi.

Danny and Baez are determined to get justice for a traumatized young woman who was held hostage, despite her resistance to press charges.

Intent on bringing justice to Lieutenant Gormley after he is beaten by a mob outside his home, Danny and Frank enlist the aid of Detective Anthony Abetemarco, who has a personal connection to the neighborhood where the attack occurred.

Danny and Baez investigate the death of an elderly woman who was shot in her home by a stray bullet. Also, Frank faces ridicule from his department when he disciplines a disrespectful cop, and Erin steps in to help her detective, Anthony.

Erin and Anthony try to prevent the deportation of a prominent community activist, Coryna Garza (Judy Reyes), who isn't a citizen, and Frank must decide if the NYPD will participate in the U.S. Marshals' high-profile raid of a local gang.

As Frank contends with a whistleblower within the NYPD who claims to have evidence of abuse of power in the organization, Danny and Baez investigate the case of a woman who was struck by a car under suspicious circumstances.
When a key witness in Danny's case is killed just before testifying, Erin angers Danny by enlisting Anthony (Steve Schrippa) to help him find the killer.

After Emily Harrison (Danielle Savre) tells Danny and Baez she's concerned her abusive ex-boyfriend will repeat his behavior with his new girlfriend, Emily becomes the prime suspect when he's murdered.
Frank is left with minimal information to find a missing boy when a conflicted priest who could help won't break the seal of confession.

When the son of Frank's most outspoken critic in the African-American community, Reverend Darnell Potter (Ato Essandoh), is killed, Potter must put aside his contentious relationship with the Reagan family to get justice for his son.
When Eddie and Jamie become overly involved in a complicated adoption case between the birth and adoptive parents, they ask Erin to help them settle the dispute without going to court.
When Danny accepts a side job as a bodyguard for a recently released ex-con who took the fall for someone else, he uses the opportunity to go after the real criminal.
When diplomatic immunity complicates a child abuse case for Danny and Baez, Frank intervenes, despite not having jurisdiction on the case.
While investigating the murder of a gang leader, Danny and Baez learn the accused shooter is an ex-con who is romantically linked to his parole officer, who might be assisting in a cover up.

While investigating the murder of a man who killed a mother and son years earlier while driving drunk, Danny and Baez are torn between doing their job and finding justice after discovering the connection between the suspect and the victim.
When Linda's brother, Jimmy (Kevin Dillon), gets into trouble with the mob, he begs Danny to help him stay safe until it blows over.

Jamie and Eddie suspect foul play when they respond to a distress call from a woman having an allergic reaction to her lifesaving medication, and learn that her husband is an EMT assigned to take her call, but didn't respond.

Danny investigates the circumstances of an ex-NYPD officer who goes missing the day after she revealed to him that she had planned to make amends to the woman she and her partner wrongfully convicted years ago.

programmes.st: Dark Enough to See the Stars
programmes.d: Young Billy Wilcox wanders onto the Ponderosa, sick, hungry, and alone.  Ben finds him, and after he regains his strength, offers Billy a job.

In this sequel to "The Waiting Game", Laura resents Adam's advice on how she ought to be running her ranch.  A newcomer, Ward Bannister, comes to her aid, but is actually part of a scheme to steal her ranch.
The Civil War once again divides the citizens of Nevada, as well as Adam and Joe Cartwright.  One of season four's highlights, the plot involving British spy Bill Stewart, based on historical fact.
An Indian-hating officer, Colonel Edward J. Dunwoody, comes to the Ponderosa looking for army deserter Bill Winters, who is a good friend of the Cartwrights.

Hoss comes upon an overturned stagecoach and discovers a little girl suffering from shock.  After the Cartwrights suceed in bringing her around, Hoss is disappointed she has relatives and cannot stay.
Hoss is suffering from spring fever, goes to the wrong town and is accused of bank robbery.
After sitting on a jury that has convicted Terrence O' Tool of murder, Joe has second thoughts about the verdict and decides to do some investigating of his own.
A young troubadour, who blames Ben for the death of his father, returns to Virginia City.  In one scene, Ben says the young man is welcome to use Adam's guitar.
Hoss and a pair of nuns, the younger one having a difficult time training for the order, are robbed and stranded at a way station.
When Joe and his friend Mitch go after a puma, Joe climbs a big peak and throws his gun up higher, intending to crawl up after it.
Hoss volunteers to pickup an injured neighbor's mail-order bride, but by the time they return, she has fallen in love with Hoss and a price is put on Hoss' head.

Virginia City's newest preacher is an ex-gunfighter who wants only to build a new church, but the brother of one of his victims has other ideas.  The blueprints for the church are said to be a gift from Adam.
Hoss and Joe find a woman abandoned by a wagon train because her gift of prophecy is considered a curse.
Adam sets out to track down the man who has been impersonating him to clear his reputation.
Hoss is seriously injured internally and Ben seeks help from the only doctor within 50 miles, who happens to be in prison for murder.
Ben finds an old journal that he kept while in a wagon train travelling from St. Joseph, Missouri to Ash Hollow.
Adam becomes involved with a quick-triggered range detective hired by the Virginia City Cattleman's Association to find out who is responsible for all the rustling going on in the area.

Unable to contain his anger towards his father for ruining Himawari�s birthday as well as his own, Boruto rushes out to confront Naruto.
Boruto manages to perfect his Rasengan and begins training under Sasuke.
Tensions run high as every participant sizes each other up, and prepare for the first round of the Chunin Exams!
Round two of the Chunin Exams begins. For the second test, three-man teams must try to capture their rival team�s flags.
The third round of the exams begins, consisting of individual battles held tournament style.
Confronted by a foe who is unbelievably calm and menacing, Cho-Cho assumes a seriousness that she rarely reveals as her teammates watch and cheer her on.

programmes.st: The Hidden Leaf vs. The Hidden Sand

Momoshiki, Kinshiki and Urashiki of the Otsutsuki Clan suddenly appear in the arena filled with spectators, and Boruto witnesses the magnitude of his father's power in real combat.
Boruto realizes the magnitude of his father's love for the village and its people and, at the same time, his own weakness.
Sasuke and the Kage wage an intense battle against the ridiculously powerful Momoshiki and Kinshiki of the Otsutsuki Clan
With Boruto watching intently, Naruto and Sasuke begin their battle against a powered-up Momoshiki!
Boruto has made his rounds apologizing to everyone for his transgressions during the exam, but Momoshiki's prophecy continues to bother him.
Popular actors Tomaru and Ashina receive death threats from an unknown person, so Team 10 is assigned to a joint mission with Team 7 to guard them.
Tomaru's flirting has Cho-Cho on Cloud 9, but Sarada and the others worry that the lovestruck Cho-Cho has lost her focus on the mission!
The ninja in the gas mask appears again during filming and kidnaps Tomaru.
Metal's father, Rock Lee, announces that he will train Metal to master the ultimate taijutsu technique, the Eight Inner Gates.

programmes.st: The Hardest Rock in the World
programmes.d: The first Five Kage Summit since the attack by the Otsutsuki Clan is held in Hidden Leaf. The current Kage as well as their predecessors assemble, except the Third Tsuchikage, Ohnoki.
The ninja assigned to the Hidden Leaf Gate are attacked, and Mitsuki disappears.

programmes.st: The Other Side of the Moon
programmes.d: The village finds out that Boruto and Sarada have gone in search of Mitsuki, and Shikadai and his Team 10 are assigned a tracking mission to bring back them back.
Orochimaru tells Boruto and Sakura about the White Snake Sage who lives in Ryuchi Cave. On their way there, the two are confronted by Team 10.
Boruto and his friends are told they must pass a series of tests in order to meet the White Snake Sage!
The White Snake Sage tells Boruto to bring back the \"Reverse Scale\" from Garaga, a troublesome snake. Boruto and his friends head deeper into Ryuchi Cave and are confronted by a giant serpent.

programmes.st: A Fierce Enemy: Garaga's Ferocious Attack!
programmes.d: Boruto and the others work together to obtain the Reverse Scale from Garaga. But the battle proves difficult, as Garaga has the power to sense the location of its enemies and turn them into stone.
Mitsuki heads toward Kokuyou and Sekiei's homeland, the Land of Earth.
Boruto and his friends manage to overcome Kokuyou, and finally catch with up Mitsuki.
Instead of returning home with Boruto, Mitsuki stays with Kokuyou.
Boruto is injured, unconscious and unable to continue. Everyone thinks about returning to the Hidden Leaf.
The team secretly enters the village determined to find Ohnoki, but they are unaware that they are being watched.
The team finds Ohnoki, but he flatly refuses to help. On top of which, they are attacked and separated.
Boruto and Ohnoki head to the rendezvous point, but they stumble into the Hidden Stone Shinobi Training Grounds
In order to get out of the barrier, Boruto desperately searches for his heart of stone, but he has little success.

The CSIs investigate when three convicted murderers are released from prison and someone starts killing them one by one.

When a beloved tennis coach is nearly killed, Calleigh discovers a personal connection to the case.

When one of the CSI's biggest enemies is murdered, Horatio must determine which of his team members is a suspect.

Mac, Stella, and Lindsay discover why a young dancer with a winning lottery ticket in her pocket was thrown from the Roosevelt Bridge Island Tram.
The witness to a brutal elevator slaying has disappeared, and as the CSIs track her down they uncover the world of Manhattan “Lolitas.”
Detective Mac Taylor and CSI Miami Lieutenant Horatio Caine follow the evidence from steamy Miami to steely New York as they close in on Henry Darius.
When murder comes to play at a high-stakes poker game, the CSIs work to find out why what they thought was a cheater’s revenge was misidentification.
In a New York doll “hospital”, Mac and Danny recover the corpse of the doll “doctor” beneath hundreds of body parts – doll body parts.
A rising roller derby star drops dead in the middle of a bout, and Mac and Stella come to the rink to investigate the death.
A billionaire is found dead in his bedroom, when Danny begins to process the scene he trips a panic button, sealing himself in with the victim.
The CSIs investigate the death of two models at New York City’s hottest fashion show-- where all of the clothes consist of nothing but body paint.
The CSIs investigate a prank gone bad when a “subway surfer” met with the ultimate wipeout, but soon understand that the death was no accident.
Stella thinks she has finally caught a night off, but the host of a private art show she’s attending is skewered with a high tech bow and arrow.

programmes.st: Is There Woogie In The House
programmes.d: An earthquake unearths a shadowy evil Woogy who promptly takes over the gasman on the Halliwell premises who promptly takes over Phoebe, who as a child most feared the Woogyman the girls’ grandma always talked about.

A dangerous mortal (guest star Alex McArthur) uses a crystal sword to suck powers out of people and targets Prue (Shannen Doherty) as his next victim. To help combat him, Prue casts a spell to strengthen her powers, only it ends up cloning her twice.

After a run in with a demon who’s responsible for the death of the sisters’ mother, Prue, Piper and Phoebe are transported back to the 1970’s after casting a spell to try to prevent her death and their loss of powers.

Prue (Shannen Doherty) tries to help Brendan (guest star Michael Weatherly) who’s two brothers (guest stars David Kriegel and Nick Kokotakis) are evil warlocks that attempt to convert him as well, forming the Evil Charmed Ones.

After the Halliwell sisters witness the kidnapping of Piper’s (Holly Marie Combs) friend (guest star Maureen Muldoon) son (guest star Scott Tera), they discover it’s the work of the Grimlocks, demons who take the sight away from young boys.
After Piper leaves town for a convention, Prue and Phoebe discover a long-dead convict has been brought to life as a ghost and is murdering people who had anything to do with his conviction.
White-Lighter Leoeturns to help rescue Daisy, a young woman on her way to becoming a White Lighter, he’s injured by the evil Alex, who once loved and is now out to get Daisy.

After repeated, unsuccessful attempts at trying to get to the Charmed Ones, Rodriguez (guest star Carlos Gomez) is aided by time sorcerer Tempus Fugit (guest star David Carradine) who traps the Halliwells in a time loop.

On their first anniversary of becoming witches, the sisters face a cloven-hoofed demon called Abraxas, that steals the Book of Shadows and undoes the spells they've cast, releasing old vanquished enemies of the Charmed Ones.

Prue tries to save a man trapped inside a painting only to get trapped herself. Piper ends up inside the painting, too, and the two sisters begin to realize the man may not be as innocent as he claims.
Leo lures the manager of Dishwalla to P3, aware that the manager has made a pact with a demon that grants him fame and fortune in exchange for innocent souls.
Pheobe has a vivid premonition foretelling her own death - burned at the stake for killing a man with her powers - in the year 2009. To prevent her execution, the sisters travel to the future.

programmes.st: She's A Man Baby, A Man!
programmes.d: When Phoebe starts to have visions and feelings of a seductress who kills only men, the Charmed Ones cast a spell to find out who the demon is. The only glitch is the spell turns Prue into a man.
When two hikers accidentally free the evil witch Tuatha, she feeds them to her enchanted serpent, just for not knowing where her jeweled wand is, then sends the serpent to find it.
Phoebe has a premonition that Collectors, a demon type who can suck a brain empty (which kills), are after a patient in the hospital where she helps out, and his cute son, Eric.
The sisters are faced with the demon that killed their mom when it decides to start killing innocents again, twenty years after her death.

programmes.d: Sam finally tells Diane he loves her, but his delivery is detrimental.
Diane is furious, when she sees that Sam and her old school chum find each other very attractive.
Kramer includes Cheers in his will when he receives a dismal prognosis.
Carla shows up at her ex-husband's wedding with Sam as her date.

Diane and Sam try to get Coach out of their hair by arranging a double date.

Norm tries to prove his manliness when his new client makes advances.
Sam hires a brilliant artist to paint Diane as a peace offering.
Diane defends her relationship with Sam to a slandering artist.

Dora and Boots are going on vacation with Diego and Baby Jaguar at the Rainforest Campground. They're packing everything they need, especially Baby Jaguar's favorite, the Dora Snacks!

programmes.st: The Big Red Chicken's Magic Wand
programmes.d: The Big Red Chicken's doing magic tricks for us today! For his first trick, he turns Boots into a chicken! But when he's going to turn him back into a monkey, he lets out a big sneeze that sends the wand flying off into Magic Land, where it breaks!

Dora and Boots are headed to a brand new playground just over the Troll Bridge.  When Dora and Boots get to the Bridge, they see that the Grumpy Old Troll's missing! Map tells us that the Troll is stuck in a magic Hole!
Dora's dance class is having a big show for all of their friends and family. Dora's starting the show, and she can't wait for her family to see her dance!
Dora and Boots are heading to the Bike Shop to pick up Boots' very first bike today.
Dora's helping her new friend, Pepe the Pig, learn all about his new school. Pepe's really excited, especially when he hears that if the class earns 3 gold stars today, they get a popcorn party!

programmes.st: Dora's Enchanted Forest Adventures Part I:  Tale of the Unicorn King
programmes.d: Unicornio has been chosen King of Enchanted Forest, but he needs help from Dora, Boots, and YOU to discover that he's kind, smart, brave and strong enough for the job!
Dora, Boots, and King Unicornio leave Enchanted Forest to join Diego in making the lost continent of Atlantis rise by ending an ancient feud between unicorns and dragons!

Dora and Boots are reading stories about knights when suddenly they hear a cry for help. It's a princess who's calling to us from the Royal Garden! It turns out that it's not the princess that needs saving—her kitty's stuck in a tree!

Swiper was packing all of his favorite things for a sleepover at his grandma's house. But just as he was about to go, a big wind came in and blew everything away! Will Swiper find a way to use his new super-Swiper-spin today?!

programmes.st: Dora's Enchanted Forest Adventures Parts 2 and 3: Dora Saves King Unicornio
programmes.d: Dora and Boots return to the Enchanted Forest to save it from Owl, who has taken over as king and set up new rules banning scarecrows, elves, and fairies from the forest! But the Enchanted Forest is for everyone!
Dora and Boots are waiting for a visit from the Hip-Hop-Bunny, who's bringing all the Easter Eggs for the big Egg Hunt! But when Swiper swipes the hip-hop bunny's basket,
When the train to the Big Horse Show breaks down, Dora, Boots, and Pinto the Pony need your help to get there with the ribbons, so Pinto can win his first blue prize ribbon!
Dora and Boots are getting ready for a big beach picnic with their friends, but when Benny gets stranded on Coconut Island, he'll need rescuing from Dora, Boots and YOU!

Join Dora for a Father's Day adventure! When the Little Kite she makes for Papi gets blown away in the wind, she'll need your help taking a hovercraft and a go-cart to catch Little Kite before she goes out over the ocean!

Dora gets to start the Big Gymnastics Show! But when Swiper swipes her special rainbow ribbon, Dora and Boots need your help on a gymnastics-filled adventure to get it back so they can begin the show! Fantastic gymnastics!
One night, while taking care of Abuela's 3 kitties, Dora awakens to find that Lucky has chased a ball of string right into a storybook world! Help her find him on a magical moonlight adventure!

Dora has a big surprise for Perrito on Surprise Hill, but Swiper's trying to get there first to swipe it! Join Dora, Boots, and Perrito for an animal-filled adventure with help from lots of friends and their playful pets too!
Everyone's getting ready for the big Thanksgiving Day parade and dinner, but the Pirate Piggies accidentally float away on Dora's boat float.

Dora's on her way to the doctor's for her yearly check up!  Dora likes going to see Dr. Valds because she gets to hear her heartbeat, see how much she's grown in one year and get a new sticker at the end of the visit!

Map has been teaching his nephew, Little Map, how to draw pictures that help us on our adventures, and today he's ready for his first treasure adventure! We help Little Map draw pictures and play map games to find the treasure at Treasure Mountain!
Dora and Boots take Baby Bongo on a musical adventure as they race to the Big Music Show in time for Baby Bongo's first performance.
Dora and Isa have been learning how the Earth's natural energy can power things we use every day. So they've made a volcano for the Science Fair!
Dora and Boots are at the beach when they find finda little lost mermaid who needs to get back to her mommy at Mermaid Cove. Together the 3 set off on an underwater adventure!
Dora and Boots discover Pincel, a cute little paintbrush who's lost and really wants to get back to Painter Daniella at the Art Studio.
An abrasive Dr. John Porter arrives in town after hearing of the discovery of dinosaur bones.
When Dr. Mike becomes the substitute school teacher, the town gets upset when she teaches the children about evolution.
Dr. Mike and Sully convince Chief Black Kettle that he should move his starving people to a new reservation. Dr. Mike and Sully are both working on wedding presents for each other.
Dr. Mike and Sully have second thoughts about their love for one another as they recall their tumultuous relationship.

While on his way to resign as Indian Agent, Sully discovers Loren badly injured in the wilderness and must battle his own despair in order to save him. Meanwhile, Dr. Mike is worried about Brian, who is consumed with his efforts to build a flying machine.
Dr. Mike and Sully go to Reverend Johnson for an honest discussion regarding their upcoming marriage.
The town of Colorado Springs is preparing for the event of a lifetime, the marriage of Sully and Dr Mike. Unexpected guests include Elizabeth Quinn and Rebecca and Marjorie.
Bolstered by the long-awaited arrival of the railroad, the citizens of Colorado Springs busily prepare for the biggest social event in the town's history, the wedding of Dr. Mike and Sully.
Dr. Mike and Sully return from their honeymoon to begin their new life as man and wife.
Baseball fever strikes Colorado Springs when a barnstorming all-star team comes to town.
Dr. Mike's passion for Sully leads to conflict with Colleen.
Matthew is grief-stricken as Dr. Mike tries to save his fiancée from a deadly disease.
Though an elderly patient believes the springs are helping him, Dr. Mike knows his improvements are psychological; Mike wants Sully to play Prince Charming.
Dr. Mike and her neighbors are up in arms when Dorothy becomes a best-selling author.
Loren proposes to Dorothy but has a stroke before she can answer; an old friend wants Sully to come to the gold fields.
Dorothy, Myra, and Grace go back to look for Mike; Preston plots to build a hotel-casino with help from his partner, Jake.
Dr. Mike worries that she cannot have a child, as Colorado Springs prepares for a Thanksgiving feast.

Blake attacks Alexis when she attempts to take over the mansion; an emotionally disturbed Claudia is trapped by a wall of flame; Sammy Jo and Amanda fight for Clay's affections; Dominique learns the truth about Garrett's first marriage.
Alexis's life is spared as Krystle is able to restrain Blake's lethal temper; as La Mirage burns, Amanda is rescued by a mysterious stranger; Claudia is claimed victim by the ravaging flames.

An incensed Blake discovers the morning headlines accusing him of murder and arson; Adam offers his loyalties to Alexis and Colbyco; Alexis acquires enough stock to assume control of Denver-Carrington.

As Krystle recovers from the accident, Alexis persuades the D.A. to suspect Blake of arson; Dominique offers Blake a 50 million dollar loan; Phill Thorpe threatens to murder Krystle in retribution against Blake.

Blake fires the La Mirage manager for withholding crucial information regarding the fire; Alexis offers a reward for the arrest and conviction of the arsonist; Michael Culhane continues to romance Amanda.

Krystle's dizzy spells force her to see a doctor; Jackie remembers seeing the La Mirage blaze start in Claudia's room, proving Blake's innocence; Blake receives a letter from Caress, pleading for his help.

Blake's trip to Caracas to free Caress proves unsuccessful; Dex's proposal of marriage to Alexis is rejected; Blake catches Michael Culhane and Amanda in a passionate embrace and immediately fires the promiscuous chauffeur.

Blake and Dex's plan to free Caress from prison succeeds, as she returns to Denver with a fever for revenge; Sammy Jo is pregnant with Clay's baby and warns Steven no court would deny her custody of Danny.

Caress vows retribution for her years of imprisonment; Michael Culhane uses Zach Powers to acquire thirty percent of "The Crater" project; Sammy Jo tells a distraught Clay of her pregnancy; Caress blackmails Emily Falimont.

Caress continues to extort Emily Fallmont; Clay, suffering from guilt, proposes marriage to Sammy Jo, Las Vega style; Michael is forced to tell Amanda the truth; Emily tells Buck of her past with Ben and fleeing from his rage.

A dying Emily begs Blake to use the letter she wrote to bring an end to Alexis and Ben's treachery; Clay and Sammy Jo are married, Nick Kimball relentlessly pursues Dominique's affections; Blake rejects Michael Culhane's efforts for a reconciliation.
Using Emily's letter, Blake devises a way to regain his empire; Sammy Jo learns she is not pregnant, but keeps it a secret from Clay; fearing Michael Culhane's deceitful intentions.
Alexis relinquishes control of Denver-Carrington and the mansion back to Blake; Ben battles Alexis for equal control of Colbyco; Michael Culhane and Alexis form an alliance against Blake.

Sammy Jo fears she will lose Clay if he learns about her false pregnancy; Adam discovers the identity of the mysterious woman tormenting Ben; An explosion rips through an oil rig, trapping Blake amidst raging flames, as Ben leaves him to die.

Ben returns to Blake's aid and pulls him to safety, both narrowly escaping the devastation of the ensuing explosion; Blake suffers memory loss due to the explosion; Alexis leads Blake to believe they have been married for the past twenty-three years.
Sammy Jo informs Clay of her desire for an annulment to their marriage; Dominique is roughed up by thugs threatening her to cooperate with their boss, as Gary Tilden coincidentally returns to Denver.
Krystle suspects Blake's once passionate feelings for Alexis may still be lingering; Blake and Ben reach a mutual reconciliation; Amanda disappears to London; Leslie Carrington finds Ben.
The team all face psychiatric evaluation, and Jess hunts for a missing legal secretary.
A federal prosecutor is kidnapped; Nicole and Antonio's relationship reaches crisis point.
The team searches for the protagonist of a school hostage situation.
Antonio, Jess and Colin forsake their vacation to help Nicole investigate the disappearance of her nephew.

Odalie tries to overcome an injury and preserve her place on the tour; Tal tries to relieve the guilt she feels and deserve Odalie's forgiveness; Rigo finds it difficult to maintain peace among his friends and find out who to trust.
With Rigo's music about to go viral, Poppy is left with no choice but to respond; Colette takes control of the tour while Sage is away; Davis helps Uncle Al outside of work.
The dancers prepare for the big opening night; Poppy's mother visits High Water; Zo gives Tal shocking news; Rigo receives unexpected help; Odalie takes a desperate last step.

The big tour begins; Dondre discovers a secret that can change everything between him and Poppy; Rigo discovers the truth about his father's death; Odalie has her moment of fame; Sage makes a dramatic proposal for Colette.

Accused of murdering his former friend East-O, Sage Odom is poised to lose everything in his empire; his partner and now fiancée Collette Jones is by his side supporting him, but Collette is hiding a deep secret.

A troubled Rigo must choose between abandoning the lucrative tour or headlining the tour to help rescue the man who possibly murdered his father; with his friend Poppy by his side, he turns the tables on Sage and Collette.
Grace and the Greenleaf family must lay the past to rest once and for all as God's plans for the future unfold.
The news of Grace Greenleaf's return to Memphis breeds tension.
Grace's moving back to Memphis is motivated by vengeance for her sister's death; she struggles to work in the family's church.

programmes.st: We Shall See Him As He Is
programmes.d: Jacob and Kerissa realize what their marriage has become; Grace goes on an uncomfortable date; Senator Banks looks into the church's finances.
When the mayor cashes in a favor, the Bishop is left in a tough spot that could split the church; Grace is blackmailed; Charity can't keep a secret.
Grace and the Bishop find themselves in opposition; Lady Mae tries to mend fences while Kerissa is pushed to her limit; Kevin further explores his sexuality.
The Bishop pushes Grace to deal with her feelings concerning the pulpit; Lady Mae admits her blame in Faith's death; Kevin's advise to Charity backfires.

Dre remains in federal custody; Jason instructs Tommy and Ghost to kidnap Alicia Jimenez; Tommy teaches LaKeisha the drug game; Tariq's business begins to flourish; Tasha has a business plan of her own.

A cannibal attack in a suburban neighborhood forces Seth to bring his team together to save innocent lives.
Genetically engineered piranhas escape a government lab and invade the waterways near a popular resort.
A couple races to save their kidnapped daughter from a dangerous man connected to the wife's secret past.
Chuck Norris plays a kickboxer hired to help cops after a martial artist starts killing their undercover unit.
Ancient Chinese warriors (Jet Li, Jackie Chan) train a kung-fu fanatic to fight a centuries-old battle.
A rookie hitman and a luckless veteran hunt the “King of Killers” for a big reward. Stars Jet Li.
Developed by the military, a massive snake escapes from its pen and stalks the residents of a small town.
A CIA agent races to recover a stolen top-secret weapon: a giant mutant snake.
John Travolta plays a rogue U.S. agent partnered with a rookie operative to stop a terrorist attack in Paris.
Kyra Sedgwick and Bella Thorne star as a mother and daughter fighting for survival when a gunman attacks.

The Angels help an alcoholic, womanizing actor (who plays an angel on television) and the young boy who idolizes him realize the true purpose of God's messengers.
The Angels help a seemingly perfect family when a teenager learns a damaging secret about his father.
The Angels help a wealthy teenager learn about humility when his family loses its money.
When a young man kills the only person who ever really believed in him, he faces a bleak future until the Angels intervene.
In order to save the life of an old friend, Andrew must help another man who is on the verge of committing suicide.
The Angels help a determined geneticist who is set on cloning a child from the DNA of Albert Einstein.
When a building explosion suddenly kills many people, Monica temporarily questions her faith in God.
The Angels are on a mission to help a woman learn the truth about the death of her beloved family, in part one of a special two-part season finale.
Monica must try to bring together a family torn apart by a tragic accident on part two of the two-part finale.
A student shares an old scroll in the Aramaic language with his professor, which sparks the hope of locating the lost Ark of the Covenant.
The Angels attend a baseball game and touch a family's heart along the way.
The Angels come to the rescue of an emotionally distraught man.
Gloria is taught a valuable lesson about love.
A group of local skinheads threaten a Jewish community.
With Monica's assistance, a man on death row seeks forgiveness.
At their 10th high school reunion, a wealthy businessman and a famous football star revisit their past.
Gloria follows a troubled teen to a rave party and ends up taking ecstasy.

This breakneck thriller teams over half a dozen of the world’s biggest action stars for the martial arts event film of the year. When a hit is taken out on a billionaire’s daughter, it’s mercenaries versus assassins in an all-out war.
While released on furlough from prison, a lowly criminal evades his guards and returns to his old haunts to take revenge on the people that made him a cold-hearted killer.
Set during the Korean War, a band of prisoners at a POW camp find distraction from the hardships of war and a new sense of freedom in dancing.
A former convict on parole must outwit the police to get his share of an old heist.

Ling Wu Chung decides to hide from the chaotic world. Before leaving, he visits his friends, a tribe of snake-wielding women warriors. However, he finds that the tribe have been attacked, and their leader Yam Ying Ying has been abducted.
This Hong Kong martial-arts extravaganza tells of evil emperors and true love. The secret Red Lotus Flower Society is committed to the overthrow of the evil Manchu Emperor and his minions.
The Cantonese hero Fong Sai Yuk becomes involved in the secret brotherhood "The Red Flower", who are trying to overthrow the Manchurian emperor and re-establishing the Ming dynasty.

Two friends, ex Shaolin monks, part ways as they brush with the ongoing rebellion against the government. The ambitious one rises up to be a powerful military commander, while his betrayed friend resorts to learn the calm ways of Tai Chi.

Charlie's laziness ruins a party when he relies on futuristic gadgets to avoid work. One gadget puts Charlie to sleep for two hundred years, and he awakes in a future where dogs are oppressed by a mysterious tyrant, the Great Deliverer.

Charlie has a sudden craving for a new dog food, Happy Hound. He is unaware that Carface has tainted the supply with a terrible mutant chemical that turns Charlie into his very own version of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde. Only Itchy can save him.

In an attempt to teach Charlie responsibility, the powers-that-be in heaven send down three young angels for him to train. But instead of being a mentor, Charlie uses the gullible pups as his personal dogs-in-waiting. Then Carface appears.

After Itchy gets hurt, Charlie complains that one dog can't make a difference in the world. So Itchy tells him a tall-tale about a secret agent who single-handedly saved the world--Double-Dog Dare, Agent from F.I.D.O.!

programmes.st: Bess And Itchy's Dog School Reunion
programmes.d: Itchy is worried about making a fool of himself at Bess' Show Dog School reunion, so Charlie stages a series of wacky masquerades to make Itchy seem rich and famous. But when Itchy gets over-confident, everything backfires.
After Scott and his rock band perform a song on a televised talent show, Scott is discovered by a record label that wants to sign him.

Scott visits his cousin, Todd, but the two have nothing in common.  As Scott tries to help Todd come out of his shell, he realizes that he and his cousin are much more alike than he initially thought.
Scott's family album of werewolves gets mixed up in the back of Mick's car. He and his friend Stiles hunt it down in order to protect the Howard family secret.
A werewolf hunter comes to the town of Wolverton. Scott and his family must find and warn Grandpa, who is hunting turkey in the woods.
Salem eats Sabrina's prize mouse for her science fair exhibit. After much blackmailing on Sabrina's part, she gets Salem to morph into a mouse to take its place.
Sabrina is psyched about school dance and can't understand why Harvey doesn't want to go.
Salem falls for a fellow feline. He learns that she is a kittywitch as well. They fall in love and want to run off together.

programmes.st: The Senses-Shattering Adventures of Captain Harvtastic
programmes.d: Harvey lacks the courage to show his comic book to the great comic book creator, King Kirby. Sabrina decides to give Harvey a wishing star in hopes that he'll wish for courage.
A rainy day traps the girls inside. In an effort to play sick, the girls create a situation where their families become part of a dire medical emergency.
The full moon has come again, and the girls are taking every precaution they can imagine this time. It proves to be in vain, however, when Rikki falls under the spell.

Cleo and Kim are fighting like crazy and Cleo is pushed to breaking point. Then cousin Angela comes to stay and things just get worse. Cleo realises there are more challenging things than an annoying sister.
Lewis enters the annual fishing derby. When Cleo sees him struggling, she decides to help him out with disastorous consequnces. Meanwhile, Rikki and Zane are trapped on a hotel balcony.

When Verne's techno-magic almost screws up a mission to the Centre of the Earth, Verne is humiliated and leaves the school. But Zarlak seizes the opportunity. Working through a magic artifact in Verne's backpack, he gives Verne evil powers.

UBOS and the kids return from an action packed chase in Rootopia, Center-earth, to find the school under a sleeping spell. They've saved a magical Rupunzel Plant from Zarlak and replant it in the school garden. However, there are bigger problems afoot.

On a white wintry day, Vonderland celebrates, “Festivus Solarus." Verne becomes smitten with a pretty young, visiting Spanish astrologer, who snubs him when she realizes he is a Mortie.  Verne feels like a misfit in both worlds, magic and Mortie.

ELSA, a young Giantess, becomes the newest student at the school and Cassy's roommate. ZARLAK takes control over LUCREZIA'S mind through a magic gemstone. He uses her to make it look like Cassy is tormenting Elsa, who finally runs away.

Zane thinks Miss Chatham holds the key to the sea monster. Emma needs a change so dyes her hair red. While Zane gets closer to the secret, he also gets closer to Rikki. Zane dives to Miss Chatham’s boat and sees a mermaid!

Emma and Cleo find out Zane and Rikki are an item and force her to choose – him or them. When Zane appears to side with Harrison over the Mako island development Rikki’s decision is clear. Now it’s Zane’s turn to make a choice…

The girls discover a necklace for sale identical to Miss Chatham’s. Miriam causes a stir by buying it – then throwing it in the water. Rikki faces a choice whether to take the necklace and reveal her mermaidness to Zane.
Lewis thinks he’s found a way to control the girl’s mermaidness. The school dance brings all our heroines' 'boy issues' to the surface.
The return of Dr. Denman means trouble for the girls. Meanwhile, Emma is having family dramas of her own. With Zane’s unwitting help, Denman’s research at Mako Island uncovers the girls' secret!
Dr. Denman has discovered the girls' secret and trapped them on Mako Island. Their only chance to avoid being exposed is to use the lunar eclipse to give up their powers forever!
In order to save his parents' marriage, Marshall must locate his dad's lost briefcase. During the search, Marhsall and Simon encounter yet another strange happening in Eerie.
Simon and Marshall are cursed on Halloween by an odd occurrence involving Simon's little brother, the TV remote control, and a scary mummy movie.
Marshall uncovers a plot by a new school nurse, who's using an eye exam to hypnotize students to make them worker drones incapable of having fun.
Marshall and a friend each want to win the heart of the same girl, who has a heart condition that brings her to Eerie hoping to have a transplant.
Gary is like any other 14-year old boy yearning for some privacy.
Selfish eight year old Shauna doesnt like to share, especially with her five year old sister Katie.
Junior High School friends Stephanie and Jan hate rules.
Evan Wagner will do anything to get out of doing his homework, including lie to his teacher.
While filling in for Frasier, Niles gains fame after counseling a local basketball star who's in a slump.
After Daphne gets dumped by her boyfriend, Niles decides it's time to declare his love for her.
Frasier and Lilith join forces so that their son can gain admission to the most prestigious private school in Boston.

programmes.st: Our Father Whose Art Ain't Heaven
programmes.d: Martin buys Frasier an expensive painting -- but Frasier doesn't have the heart to tell his father that he hates it.

programmes.st: Dad Loves Sherry the Boys Just Whine
programmes.d: Frasier and Niles disapprove of Martin's relationship with his brassy new girlfriend.
Frasier finds himself in a precarious position when he tries to help the troubled marriage of a former high school acquaintance.
When Frasier becomes fed up with the rules and regulations governing his condominium complex, he decides to run for condo board president.
When Eddie shows signs of depression, a pet therapist thinks Martin's dog is simply reacting to the dysfunctional Crane family!
When the Crane brothers go away for the weekend with two attractive women, Niles discovers he hasn't quite cut his emotional ties to Maris.
Niles moves into a prestigious building and tries to impress his snobby neighbors with an elegant dinner party.

programmes.st: Roz's Krantz and Gouldenstein Are Dead
programmes.d: While volunteering at a retirement home, Roz becomes convinced that she's "the angel of death" after her first two patients die on her.
Rather than show his son that his dad's not perfect, Frasier agrees to join the station's softball team -- even though he has no idea how to play the game.
When an on-air hosting spot opens up at the station, Roz decides to go for it -- but Frasier's agent has other ideas.
Frasier's attempts to produce a live, 1940s-style radio drama for the station's fiftieth anniversary produce chaos instead.
While Frasier tries to juggle three dates in three days, Martin and his girlfriend face the prospect of breaking up.
Frasier tries to get Martin and Sherry to reconcile -- to the detriment of his own love life.
Frasier and Niles are caught in the middle when Martin's girlfriend and Daphne can't stop bickering.
Frasier tries to console Niles after Maris serves him with divorce papers.
When Niles asks Frasier whether he and Maris belong together, Frasier goes out of his way to give his brother an honest, thoughtful response.
Frasier comes down with a case of the "bachelor blues" when he realizes that every single person he knows is dating someone -- except him.
Nobody believes Frasier when he claims to be dating a famous supermodel.
The sibling rivalry between Frasier and Niles reaches a fever pitch when they try and "top" each other's 65th birthday gift to their father, Martin.
Niles' Halloween costume party becomes a comedy of errors when he mistakenly thinks that Daphne is pregnant -- and Frasier's the father.
